title: Dubai: job promises used to force women into prostitution (Al Hamriya)
summary: On 20 August 2020 the Dubai Criminal Court convicted seven people, four Bangladeshi citizens, a Pakistani man and two Indonesian women, of human trafficking, unlawful confinement and forcing women into prostitution in a flat in Dubai's Al Hamriya district. Six were sentenced to seven years in prison and one Indonesian woman to one year for aiding and abetting, all to be deported afterwards. Victims were deceived with promises of better-paid work in Dubai; one, an Indonesian domestic worker already in the UAE, was encouraged to leave her employer for a supposedly better job. The case broke when a victim used an open Wi-Fi network on a phone without a SIM card to reach her sister on Facebook, and police raided the flat. The convicted are not named in the report.
